out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. Provide additional employees to be certified in foods safety and ensure that one is always on site during operation of the restaurant.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at kitchen handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked barley=49, cooked beef=43F, beef broth=49F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Corrected during the inspection. Items observed were discarded.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: Unmarked food containers with hard to identify foods, unmarked squeeze bottles with liquids, sauces, and dressings, that cannot be easily identified.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. Corrected during the inspection.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the back door top the kitchen..
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. You may install a weather stripping at the base of the door to seal the existing gap, to prevent entry of pest into the food preparation and storage areas

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observe in use knife stored in-between a prep table and a wall, at the cook-line.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Multi-Use Food-Contact Surfaces, Smooth/Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: The food-contact surface of the following equipment contains cracks, chips, or pits and cannot be easily cleaned: a wooden knife rack with knives were knitted in the kitchen. This wooden rack was not designed to be used in food establishment and it al;so v=cannot be easily cleaned. This rack is designed to be used in at a household.
violations.corrective_action: Multiuse food-contact surfaces shall be: 1) smooth, 2) free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, inclusions, pits, and similar imperfections, 3) free of sharp integral angles, corners, and crevices, 4) finished to have smooth welds and joints, and 5) accessible for cleaning and inspection. Cleaning and inspection shall be completed by one of the following methods: (a) without being disassembled, (b). by disassembling without the use of tools, or (c) by easy disassembling with the use of handheld tools. Rack discarded during the inspection by the PIC.

out_items.name: Sewage and waste water properly disposed

violations.title: Grease Trap, Location for Easy Access
violations.observation: MOP SINK has been installed in a manner preventing easy access for cleaning and use. The sink is presently blocked by a long and large size stainless steel prep table.
violations.corrective_action: The mop sink must be easily accessible for cleaning and for use, to ensure that waste water is properly dispensed and soiled mop heads are properly cleaned.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Premises Free of Unnecessary Items/Equipment
violations.observation: Observed that items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment are being stored on the premises.
violations.corrective_action: Remove unnecessary items, including equipment which is no longer in use, from the premises to allow for regular and effective cleaning and to prevent harborage conditions.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floor and walls misunderstood stationary equipment are in need of cleaning.debris observed under the equipment.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Clean and maintain the floors often to prevent buildup of debris.

violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the front serving station is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. Remove the equipment the is blocking the hand sink.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Cover Foods in Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped or uncovered food in the following location where the food is subject to contamination: Observed uncovered and unwrapped foods inside the refrigerator and freezer, exposing foods to possible contamination and cross contamination.
violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled. Wrap or cover foods properly to protect them from being contaminated.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Eliminate Harborage Conditions
violations.observation: Harborage conditions exist. Storage racks, equipment, shelving, have debris buildup. The floor under cooking equipment has grease and debris accumulation. Equipment surfaces soiled with food residues and dust.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. Eliminate harborage conditions to control and prevent the presence of pests on the premises. Remove what is not necessary for the operation of the restaurant, and maintain the facilities in a clean condition.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Several food containers and bags were observed, stored directly on the floor, in the dry storage areas of the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.

out_items.name: Personal cleanliness

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area/kitchen without proper hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: Inverted cooking utensils and equipment such as frying pans, p;its were spiked with lots of debris.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Protect utensils and equipment from being recontaminated after they have been cleaned.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The Flat -top refrigerated preparation table on the cook-line is not draining causing water/liquid to pool or build-up on the interior of the equipment.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. repair this refrigerator top properly drain.

violations.observation: Observed that the @Physical structure@ in the @Location@ is in need of cleaning. The floor under equipment, the wall at the 3-compartment sink station, and the piping under the 3-compartment were observed to be spoiled and in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. Information on procedure on how to clean in English and Spanish, was provided during the inspection.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at the kitchen handwashing sink used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: yucca, marinara sauce(home made),
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees.
